payload.description: You built something with Claude or Gemini — now what? This guide walks you through two practical paths to deploying your AI-built app online: Google AI Studio for fast, hosted prototypes in under 30 minutes, and GitHub + Netlify for full customization and deep integrations.
payload.name: How to Get Your AI-Built App on the Internet
